feeds.title: GovCon Wire
feeds.description: GovCon Wire provides informative, to-the-point stories of the most significant and the most recent contracting sector activity news of the government contracting industry. The blog is filled with articles and news on government contracting.

feeds.title: Federal Tax Procedure Blog
feeds.description: Jack Townsend offers the Federal Tax Procedure blog in conjunction with his Federal Tax Procedure Books, currently in the 2019 editions (Student and Practitioner). In addition, Jack uses this blog to discuss issues of federal tax procedures.

feeds.title: Paul Mollica's Federal Courts Blog
feeds.description: Read more about developments in civil procedure, evidence, and jurisdictional law in the U.S. Courts of Appeals. Paul W. Mollica's background includes class and individual representation in employment discrimination and employee benefit/ERISA litigation. He has wide appellate experience, including dozens of appeals in state and federal courts, and has authored or co-authored amicus briefs in the U.S. Supreme Court and Courts of Appeals for such national organizations as the Lawyers' Committee for Civil Rights Under Law, ACLU, NAACP, AARP, and NELA.

feeds.title: My Federal Retirement
feeds.description: My Federal Retirement is the leading provider of financial and retirement planning information for federal and postal employees. Get federal retirement planning resources for those in Federal Employees Retirement System (FERS), Civil Service Retirement System (CSRS), Thrift Savings Plan (TSP) and more.

feeds.title: Fed Law Blog
feeds.description: The Federal Employment Law Firm of Aaron D Wersing has experience with all types of legal issues affecting federal employees, including disability claims, discrimination and harassment, whistleblower claims, retaliation, wrongful termination, and other adverse employment actions. Explore our blog to get a better understanding of laws affecting federal employees, their rights and ,more!

feeds.title: Federal Employee Law Blog
feeds.description: A national firm dedicated to helping federal employees. Harris Federal Law Firm fights for the rights of injured and disabled federal employees nationwide. Get the latest updates on federal employee laws, information and more!

feeds.title: FEDweek
feeds.description: The information resource for federal and military employees and retirees, helping you get the most out of your government career and retirement. FEDweek is the most widely-circulated information resource in the federal government. For over 20 years FEDweek has helped federal and military employees and retirees get the most out of their careers and the federal benefits they have earned.

feeds.title: FedSmith.com
feeds.description: FedSmith.com is a free news service for federal employees and retirees on topics such as pay, benefits, retirement and the Thrift Savings Plan (TSP). FedSmith.com is your one-stop Federal Government news and information resource.

feeds.title: Federal Reserve Board
feeds.description: The Federal Reserve System is the central bank of the United States. It performs five general functions to promote the effective operation of the U.S. economy and, more generally, the public interest. Browse through the latest news and press coverage of the Federal Reserve.

feeds.title: NIST
feeds.description: National Institute of Standards and Technology Blog provides a behind-the-scenes look at NIST's research and programs, covering a broad range of science and technology areas in the Taking Measure segment. Founded in 1901, NIST is one of the nation's oldest physical science laboratories that work towards advancing measurement science, standards, and technology in ways that enhance economic security and improve our quality of life.

feeds.title: Nextgov/FCW
feeds.description: Nextgov's mission is to lead the national discussion about how technology and innovation are transforming the way government agencies serve citizens and perform vital functions. Nextgov provides Federal technology news, best practices, and web 2.0 tools.

feeds.title: GovExec
feeds.description: Government Executive is the leading source for news, information and analysis about the operations of the executive branch of the federal government. Government Executive is government's business news daily and the premier digital destination for senior leaders in the federal government's departments and agencies. Our readers are the high-ranking civilian and military officials who are responsible for defending the nation and carrying out the laws that define the government's role in our economy and society.

feeds.title: U.S. Department of Education Blog
feeds.description: The blog articles provide insights on the activities of schools, programs, grantees, and other education stakeholders to promote continuing discussion of educational innovation and reform. U.S. Department Of Education aims to promote student achievement and preparation for global competitiveness by fostering educational excellence and ensuring equal access.

feeds.title: Federal Trade Commission News
feeds.description: We strive to engage and inform consumers and businesses about the agency's work to protect consumers and competition. Learn about the latest cases and other developments from our news releases, blogs, features, and event listings. Our mission is protecting consumers and competition by preventing anticompetitive, deceptive, and unfair business practices through law enforcement, advocacy, and education without unduly burdening legitimate business activity.

feeds.title: MeriTalk Blog
feeds.description: We have the must-read IT blog for federal government IT leaders. Read stories on systems, projects, strategy, solutions, and more from our experts. MeriTalk is a public-private partnership focused on improving the outcomes of government IT.

feeds.title: Federal News Network
feeds.description: Federal News Network is the key source of breaking news, information and analysis on the topics that matter most to federal agency managers, policy makers and contractors. We cover the federal government and those who do business with the government, concentrating on workforce, management, defense, technology, contracting, policy, and pay and benefits issues.

feeds.title: Partnership for Public Service
feeds.description: The Partnership for Public Service is a nonprofit, nonpartisan organization that strives for a more effective government for the American people. Dive into the Partnership's reports, podcasts, videos, blog posts, and more.

feeds.title: U.S. GAO Blog
feeds.description: GAO provides Congress, the heads of executive agencies, and the public with timely, fact-based, non-partisan information that can be used to improve government and save taxpayers billions of dollars. GAO is an independent, nonpartisan agency working for Congress, examining how tax dollars are spent.

feeds.title: Federal Times
feeds.description: Covering the federal workforce, acquisition, IT adoption and management issues for a new era of public service. With nearly 60 years of history covering what matters to federal employees, Federal Times is dedicated to providing government workers with the information they need to do their jobs and make decisions for their careers. Federal Times brings concise, unbiased coverage on federal pay, benefits and policy changes on a daily basis.

feeds.title: Liberty Street Economics
feeds.description: Liberty Street Economics features insight and analysis from New York Fed economists working at the intersection of research and policy. Launched in 2011, the blog takes its name from the Bank's headquarters at 33 Liberty Street in Manhattan's Financial District.

feeds.title: Cohen Seglias Law Firm | Federal Construction Contracting Blog
feeds.description: This publication offers legal information & resources for federal construction contractors including those involved in military and civil works construction. The first of its kind, Federal Construction Contracting provides timely coverage of legal issues facing federal construction contractors including small and disadvantaged businesses by the attorneys in Cohen Seglias' Government Contracting Group.

feeds.title: Federal Circuitry
feeds.description: Federal Circuitry is a data-driven Federal Circuit blog. Our Federal Circuit Statistics empirically analyze quantifiable aspects of the Court. Our En Banc Tracker highlights pending and past petitions. Our Substantive Order Tracker allows you to search less-discussed orders.

feeds.title: Federal Government Jobs Blog
feeds.description: This career center was developed to help federal government job hunters find, apply for, and land government jobs. It was expanded to assist federal employees seeking upward mobility, career progression, and retirement planning assistance. Federal Jobs Net also includes comprehensive Postal employment information, information about overseas jobs, law enforcement opportunities, and detailed information on Veteran's benefits, handicapped employment options, and special emphasis hiring programs. This site was Launched in 1994. Today, FederalJobs.net is owned and operated by Federal Media Network.

feeds.title: Civil Procedure & Federal Courts Blog
feeds.description: Civil Procedure & Federal Courts Blog is a collective blog written by multiple professors of law. Get all the information about the Law Professor Blogs Network.

feeds.title: Federal Defenders of New York Blog
feeds.description: The Federal Defenders of New York is an independent, non-profit organization that represents poor people accused of federal crimes in the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York and in the Second Circuit Court of Appeals. This blog aims to support the New York federal criminal defense bar by reporting on recent decisions in the Second Circuit and the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York as well as other information that relates to criminal defense practice.

feeds.title: Federal Retirement Services Blog
feeds.description: Whether it's taking that bucket list trip, spending more time with your grandchildren, or finally learning how to play that one instrument, we're here to make sure you live the life you want in retirement. Explore our blog to know about all the rights you have as federal employee about to retire or retired.

feeds.title: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau Blog
feeds.description: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau is a 21st century agency that implements and enforces Federal consumer financial law and ensures that markets for consumer financial products are fair, transparent, and competitive. Find blog posts published by the Bureau.

feeds.title: Kevin Federal | Federal Markets
feeds.description: This site is designed to Empower Federal Sales. So whether you are an individual Federal Salesperson looking to grow your personal pipeline or an organization trying to stand up or grow a Federal Sales practice, this site is for you. Get the latest updates along with information on federal markets.

feeds.title: Federal Employee Law Blog
feeds.description: Our law firm, Berry & Berry, PLLC, practices federal employment law and represents federal employees nationwide in various matters, including security clearance cases, disciplinary and adverse actions, Merit Systems Protection Board (MSPB) appeals, Inspector General investigations, Equal Employment Opportunity complaints and appeals, retirement cases before the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and many other types of federal personnel issues. Our blog provides information on various areas of interest to federal employees.

feeds.title: ExecutiveBiz Blog
feeds.description: ExecutiveBiz follows the executive-level business activity that drives the government contracting industry. Covering the people and companies making business news in & around Washington, DC. Our writers and researchers follow the political and business trends associated with contracting to find those who matter most to those who make decisions.

feeds.title: ExecutiveGov
feeds.description: ExecutiveGov is dedicated to the news and headlines in the federal government. It serves as a news source for the top trends and issues facing federal government agencies and how they influence the government contracting market. Find the latest news on contracts, laws and more.

feeds.title: Downsize The Federal Government
feeds.description: This website is designed to help policymakers and the public understand where federal spending goes and how to reform each government department. It describes the failings of agencies and identifies specific programs to cut. It also discusses the systematic reasons why government programs are often obsolete, mismanaged, or otherwise dysfunctional. Downsizing the Federal Government is a project of the Cato Institute. Scholars at Cato believe that cutting the federal budget would enhance personal freedom, increase prosperity, and leave a positive fiscal legacy to the next generation.

feeds.title: Digital.gov News and Updates
feeds.description: Explore innovative work, news, and ideas from people and teams in government. We help the government community deliver better digital services. Our mission is to transform how government learns, builds, delivers, and measures digital services in the 21st century. And we do that by providing people in the federal government with the tools, methods, practices, and policy guidance they need to deliver effective and accessible digital services.

feeds.title: Federal Register
feeds.description: The Daily Journal of the United States Government. Increase your understanding of the Federal Register eco-system and improve your Federal Register skills with these helpful, unofficial educational articles.

feeds.title: U.S. Department of Justice
feeds.description: Official website of the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ). DOJ's mission is to enforce the law and defend the interests of the United States according to the law; to ensure public safety against threats foreign and domestic; to provide federal leadership in preventing and controlling crime; to seek just punishment for those guilty of unlawful behavior; and to ensure fair and impartial administration of justice for all Americans. Get the latest news and updates from DOJ.
